method: Continuous native game AutoWalk on the default 450 m OSM route, first-person, Eco, 640×360, June afternoon clear. No relocation, speed/time change or replay. Twelve-second rest at the end. Real post-limiter audio and VP8/Opus frame times, remux only. Per-frame data drained to Node every five seconds to bound instrumentation. SwiftShader, not physical GPU performance. Frame intervals include recording overhead.
